portInfo.description: Tel Aviv is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Tel Aviv destination (ocean cruise pier not verified)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Usually motorcoach from Haifa (~1–1.5 h typical traffic-dependent — unverified) or Ashdod (shorter). Confirm onboard.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Usually motorcoach from Haifa (~1–1.5 h typical traffic-dependent — unverified) or Ashdod (shorter). Confirm onboard.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not assume you can walk off a ship into downtown Tel Aviv.
